sentences.text: Flavio Cattaneo, born in Rho, Italy, in 1963, is an architecture graduate of the Politecnico di Milano who also specialised in finance applied to real estate at SDA Bocconi.

sentences.quote: From 2005 to 2014 he was CEO of Terna, within whose Group he also served from 2007 to 2011 as chairman of the board of directors of Terna Participacoes, a Brazilian electricity grid operator
sentences.text: He was deputy chairman of AEM Milano (now A2A) from 1998 to 2001, chairman and chief executive of Fiera Milano from 1999 to 2003, general manager of RAI from 2003 to 2005, and then CEO of Terna from 2005 to 2014, chairing Brazilian grid operator Terna Participacoes from 2007 to 2011.

mgmt_bio.text: He was deputy chairman of AEM Milano (now A2A) from 1998 to 2001, chairman and chief executive of Fiera Milano from 1999 to 2003, general manager of RAI from 2003 to 2005, and then CEO of Terna from 2005 to 2014, chairing Brazilian grid operator Terna Participacoes from 2007 to 2011. He led Telecom Italia as CEO between 2016 and 2017 and NTV-Italo in 2014-2016 and 2017-2018. He has been CEO of Enel since 12 May 2023, chair of Enel Iberia and vice chair of Endesa, and sits on the board of Assicurazioni Generali. Enel's board, appointed by the May 2026 shareholders meeting, confirmed him as CEO and general manager.

sentences.text: Under Flavio Cattaneo, Enel completed the disposal plan announced in 2022 and cut debt, reaching a net financial debt/EBITDA ratio of 2.5x in 2025, with ordinary EBITDA converting into net ordinary income at about 30%, roughly six percentage points above the 2020-2022 average, and EPS growing about 9% a year since 2022.

sentences.quote: In 2023-2025, Enel therefore guaranteed growth and returns to shareholders, with around 15 billion euros distributed between dividends and a share buy-back program.
sentences.text: Capital allocation has tilted toward regulated grids, and around 15 billion euros was distributed via dividends and buybacks in 2023-2025, while the 2026-2028 plan raises investment to 53 billion euros and temporarily lifts leverage to about 3x.

sentences.quote: The Italian state, through the Ministry of Economy and Finance, is the company's largest shareholder, holding 23.6% of its share capital as of 31 December 2024.
sentences.text: Governance reflects state influence, with the Italian economy ministry holding 23.6% and Paolo Scaroni as chairman.

citations.title: Strategic Plan 2026-2028

sentences.text: Enel SpA's 2026-2028 strategic plan, presented at its February 23, 2026 Capital Markets Day by CEO Flavio Cattaneo and CFO Stefano De Angelis, commits about 53 billion euros of investment through 2028, roughly 10 billion more than the prior plan, focused on grids, renewables and end customers, with about half going to power grids and around 38% to renewables.

sentences.quote:
Improving the risk/return profile
for greater predictability and stability for future results.
sentences.text: The plan rests on three stated pillars: growth based on balance sheet flexibility, productivity through capital allocation and efficiency, and a preserved low risk/return profile based on assets with visible, predictable returns.

sentences.quote:
approximately EUR 20 billion in Renewables
with the goal of adding roughly 15 GW of new capacity, of which more than 75% will be in wind power and BESS, reaching more than 80 GW of renewable capacity by 2028.
sentences.text: Renewables spending of roughly 20 billion euros targets about 15 GW of additions, over 75% in wind and storage, for more than 80 GW of renewable capacity by 2028.
Shareholder returns are framed by a 2028 EPS target of 0.80-0.82 euros, a dividend CAGR near 6%, and a 1 billion euro buyback.
